content: 1. The enzyme CYP3A4 is involved in the metabolism of many drugs. Fexinidazole inhibits CYP3A4, which can lead to increased levels or effects of drugs metabolized by this enzyme. Co-administration of fexinidazole with CYP3A4 substrates may increase the risk of adverse effects. It is recommended to avoid or use an alternative drug. 2. Fexinidazole increases the levels or effects of mefloquine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. 3. Fexinidazole increases the levels or effects of melatonin by inhibiting CYP1A2 metabolism.
